lines: Lost two arrows, kept my nerve. I'll call that a fair trade.
My quiver is lighter, but so is my heart now that I am inside the village again.
I counted arrows until counting steps mattered more.
My hands remembered what to do before my head caught up.
I made it back with an empty quiver and a full respect for walls.
The road home felt like a target I could barely see.
A steady breath is harder when the dark is shouting.
I lost my aim for a moment. I did not lose the way home.
